proxy_help: Only configured applications use the proxy. HTTP uses SOCKS port + 1.
tunnel_help: TUN routes IPv4 and IPv6. This development build has not passed device leak or recovery tests.
empty: No profiles yet. Import your own server configuration.
rules_help: Each rule: domains, ips (CIDR), action: proxy/direct/block. Split routing happens inside the core; applications remain captured by TUN.
advanced_help: Only a single supported outbound is accepted. File access, custom listeners and unsafe TLS options are rejected.
backup_help: Device/account-bound encrypted backup. Not portable to another device.
privacy: No accounts. No telemetry. Profiles stay on this device. Subscriptions contact their provider; connection checks contact Cloudflare through your proxy.
development: Development build · not a verified public release
listening: Local core running; reachability checked separately
invalid_profile: Invalid profile. Check the supported link format.
unsupported_feature: Unsupported protocol, transport or parameter. No silent substitution was made.
invalid_settings: Invalid mode, port, MTU or rule count.
loopback_only: Only loopback bind addresses are allowed.
invalid_dns: DNS must contain valid IPv4 / IPv6 addresses.
unsupported_platform: Tunnel mode is unavailable on this platform.
core_config_invalid: Xray rejected the configuration. Credentials were not logged.
core_start_failed: Could not start Xray. Check port conflicts, elevation and Wintun availability.
probe_failed: HTTPS through the proxy failed. The connection was closed. Check server access.
invalid_url: Use a valid HTTPS subscription URL without embedded login.
subscription_failed: Subscription download failed. Existing profiles were kept.
cleanup_failed: Cleanup failed. Check your system network settings.
storage_failed: Secure storage failed. No plaintext fallback is used.
operation_failed: Operation failed. No sensitive details were logged.
socket_protect_failed: Unable to protect the outbound socket.
name: Profile name
admin: Tunnel mode requires administrator rights and wintun.dll. Start RADVPN as administrator.
tcp_help: Direct TCP reachability only; not a VPN handshake or traffic-protection test. Tests use four workers and a 3-second timeout; up to 256 profiles per batch.
import_hint: Bring your own server. Import a supported link or an outbound JSON file to begin.
history_help: Measured proxy bytes only, including the HTTPS probe; direct/bypass traffic is excluded. Totals are sampled locally and saved every 15 seconds. A forced termination may lose the most recent samples.
autoconnect_help: Automatic startup connection is supported only in Local Proxy mode. Tunnel still requires an explicit elevated launch.
confirm_reset: Reset connection settings? Profiles and traffic history are preserved.
ipv6_block: Tunnel IPv4; request WFP IPv6 blocking
ipv6_help: Windows-only tunnel policy. Actual IPv6 and leak behavior must still be tested on your system. It does not change proxy-only application routing.
logging_fixed: Raw core logs are disabled to protect credentials. Safe lifecycle events remain available.
ports_free: Both TCP ports are available now. Startup remains authoritative because another process can claim them.
ports_busy: One or both local TCP ports are in use.
driver_present: Wintun file present; driver load, routes and DNS have not been tested by this check.
driver_missing: Wintun file is missing. Reinstall the complete package.
last_working_help: A successful proxy HTTPS check saves an encrypted recovery snapshot. This is not proof of whole-device tunnel protection.
no_backup: No successful connection snapshot exists yet.
save_cancel: Changes apply only after Save. Cancel discards the draft.
remove_sub: Remove this subscription and its profiles?
refresh_failed: Refresh failed; existing profiles were kept.
import_json_help: JSON import accepts a supported outbound, an outbound array, or an object containing only outbounds. Other full-config sections are rejected.
not_full_protection: Tunnel protection is not device-verified. Do not rely on this build for safety-critical privacy.
no_history: No recorded traffic for this period
safe_name: Names and URLs are excluded from exported diagnostics.
storage_recovered: Encrypted backup recovered after the primary vault could not be read.
not_installed_driver: No driver is installed by setup; Tunnel loads the bundled vendor driver only after an elevated Connect action.
core_loaded: Core IPC ready (not a connected VPN)
qr_help: Scan a trusted profile QR code. Camera permission is requested by the scanner.
android_refresh_help: Refresh is manual on Android. Downloads contact only your subscription provider; existing profiles survive failed refreshes.
android_ipv6_help: Android Tunnel requests IPv4 and IPv6 routes. This app has no independent kill switch; device leak tests are still required.
android_traffic_help: Actual current-session proxy counters. The graph contains only samples collected while this screen/app is visible; no historical totals are invented.
android_testing_channel: Android design update 1 · debug-signed testing build · not production verified
no_events: No recorded events in this app session.
theme_description: Dark blue-black surfaces, orange accents. No unsupported theme toggle.
